title: Watching the Watchers: A Comparative Fairness Audit of Cloud-based Content Moderation Services

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities in hate speech detection using group-level pinned ROC AUC and measuring counterfactual fairness via Perturbation Sensitivity Analysis (PSA) by substituting gender identity tokens (e.g., 'woman', 'women') to compute Counterfactual Token Fairness (CFT) scores.
